title: HCN (1‒0) opacity of outflowing gas in Arp 220W
question: What is the HCN/H13CN 1-0 line ratio, and hence the HCN 1-0 opacity, in the molecular outflow of Arp 220W?

what.value: HCN/H13CN 1-0 ratio of about five for whole Arp 220 (IRAM 30m)

evidence.quote: The HCN/H$^{13}$CN 1-0 ratio in the entire system of Arp 220 is about five according to single-dish observations with IRAM 30-meter telescope

evidence.loc: 4.1 HCN 1-0 opacity in the outflowing gas
evidence.quote: The $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C ratio in Arp 220 was updated to be 40 with ALMA observations of $^{12}$CO 3-2 and $^{13}$CO 4-3

evidence.loc: 4.1 HCN 1-0 opacity in the outflowing gas

recipe.method: tclean cube with natural weighting; continuum from line-free channels; velocity-integrated maps of HCN and H13CN wings

recipe.goal: Measure wing fluxes and line ratio limits
recipe.method: Integrate spectra over red 5620-5800 and blue 4860-5040 km/s; 3 sigma upper limits for H13CN; ratio in brightness temperature
key_parameters: uncertainty = sigma_rms x sqrt(dv DeltaV), dv ~13.2 km/s, DeltaV=180 km/s

recipe.method: Ratio of line intensities with tau(H13CN)/tau(HCN) set by 13C/12C abundance ratio

evidence.quote: 794.1$\pm$27.7 mJy km s$^{-1}$ for the blue wing

answer_key.quantity: HCN/H13CN 1-0 ratio lower limit, red and blue wings

evidence.quote: line ratios of HCN/H$^{13}$CN 1-0 greater than 9.5 and 9.7 in the red and blue wings

answer_key.quantity: HCN/H13CN ratio lower limit, combined wings

evidence.loc: 4.1 HCN 1-0 opacity in the outflowing gas
evidence.quote: which gives a ratio of greater than 13.3

not_stated_but_needed: Exact coordinates and distance of Arp 220W
Beam size and rms of the cubes
score_reason: Public data and simple recipe, but imaging and extraction details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple flux and ratio calculation with numeric limits, though extraction regions are not given.
